extraction_notes: The exact target is JSM2301S from JSMSEMI, LCSC C916399; the supplied datasheet title includes the JSM2301S-2A suffix.

The supplied three-page PDF contains package, marking, equivalent-circuit, maximum-rating, and electrical-characteristics tables but no transfer, output, or capacitance plots; no curve points were invented or interpolated.
P-channel voltage and current values retain the signed values printed in the datasheet. Resistance values are positive SI quantities.
Both typical and maximum RDS(ON) values are transcribed for both published VGS and ID conditions.

The strict MOSFET schema has no fields for absolute maximum ratings, IDSS, IGSS, operating/storage temperature, power dissipation, or thermal resistance; those published values were not added outside schema. CISS, COSS, CRSS, and source-drain diode forward voltage are not provided in the electrical-characteristics table and are null.
extraction.omission_reason: The supplied three-page PDF contains no usable electrical characteristic plots; it provides only tabulated ratings and characteristics, so curves is empty.
